login.title: Ngena ngemvume kwemlingani wesiteshi
login.welcome: Siyakwemukela futsi! Ngena ngemvume kute ulawule imikhondo yakho.
login.heroTitle: Khulisa ibhizinisi lakho le-real-estate ngayo yonkhe indlela loyiletsako
login.heroIntro: I-portal yinye yekubhalisa emakhasimende nebakhi, gcina sikweleti sekuhola kwakho bese ubalandzela kuze kube sekubhukeni.

register.title: Bhalisa imikhondo ngemizuzwana
register.text: Tfumela likhasimende lakho kanye nephrojekthi labayitsandzako.

protect.title: Kuvikeleka lokuphindvwe kabili
protect.text: Umholi wakho uhlala wakho sikhatsi sekuvikeleka, ngako kute lomunye longacela likhasimende lelifanako.

track.title: Landzela sonkhe sigaba
track.text: Bona simo semholi ngamunye kanye nemlandvo lophelele, kusukela ekuchumaneni kwekucala kuya ekubhukheni.

handover.title: Sikweleti ngesikhatsi ubhuka
handover.text: Uma ikhasimende libhukha, umholi uniketwa umakhi nawe ubhalwe njengemlingani wemtfombo.

login.secure: Ngena ngemvume ngendlela lephephile - imininingwane yemakhasimende akho ihlale iyimfihlo

signup.title: Kubhalisa Kwebalingani Besiteshi
signup.intro: Dala i-akhawunti yakho kute ucale kubhalisa nekulawula imikhondo yakho.
